summary: Aggregate a GeoZarr dataset to DHIS2 org units and export CHAP CSV

parameters.name: dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the published GeoZarr collection to aggregate (as listed under /datasets).

parameters.name: temporal_extent
parameters.description: Time range to load as [start, end] ISO-8601 date strings.

parameters.name: geometries
parameters.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of organisation units. Each feature's `id` becomes the CSV `location`.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Spatial aggregation method applied to the pixels within each org unit: mean (default), min, max, sum, or median.

parameters.name: period_type
parameters.description: Period type used to format each time step as `time_period` (day, week, month, quarter, year). Should match the dataset's native temporal resolution.
